info.title: EmailTemplates
info.description: Email templates provide the data needed to construct email content for various modules. Templates define the subject, body, and metadata used for notifications, replies, and automated communications across tickets, contacts, accounts, products, and tasks.

get.description: Retrieves a list of email templates for the specified department, with pagination support.

parameters.name: searchStr
parameters.description: String to search for templates by name. The string must contain at least one character. Three search methods are supported: prefix search (append a trailing wildcard character to match names that start with the string), substring search (wrap the string with leading and trailing wildcard characters to match names that contain the string), and exact match (pass the string with no wildcard characters).

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the department for which placeholders are retrieved.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Name of the module to filter templates.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Number of templates to retrieve. Valid range is 1 to 1000.

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: Index number from which templates must be fetched.

parameters.name: folderId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the folder from which templates must be fetched.

post.description: Clones the attachments of an existing template for reuse.

get.description: Retrieves the list of placeholders supported in email templates for the specified module and department.

parameters.name: departmentId
parameters.description: Unique ID of the department for which placeholders are retrieved.

parameters.name: module
parameters.description: Module for which placeholders are retrieved. Possible values: tickets, tasks, contacts, accounts, products, solutions, calls, events.
